steps.text: The installer is a GUI (no silent mode): pick the install path and let it download the client. Battle.net's login is CEF-based like Steam's — keep sync: none. Historically the top-1 Whisky issue (54 comments); expect login flakiness.

knownIssues.cause: CEF under Wine; historically broken on CrossOver-derived engines too
knownIssues.fix: retry; keep sync none; disable hardware acceleration in Battle.net settings once in
